name: mermaid-render
description: Check Mermaid diagrams for the mistakes that stop them rendering (unknown diagram type, unbalanced brackets or quotes, unquoted parentheses in labels, the word end as a node id, missing arrows, unclosed subgraphs or alt blocks) with line numbers and a fix for each, then render them to SVG, PNG or PDF with mermaid-cli, or to a standalone HTML page when it is not installed. Works on a .mmd file or every mermaid fence in a Markdown doc. Use when a diagram "won't render", the user says "check my mermaid", "export this diagram as SVG/PNG", or needs the diagrams in a doc as image files.

handoff.when: the diagrams are rendered and the doc around them needs sharing
handoff.purpose: Embed the SVGs in a self-contained HTML file that works offline.
handoff.fallback: If md-to-html is absent, give the user the SVG paths and the Markdown image lines (![…](figures/x-1.svg)) to paste in place of each fence.

permissions.notes: mmdc (mermaid-cli) renders SVG, PNG and PDF if it is installed. Without it the script writes an HTML page that loads Mermaid from cdn.jsdelivr.net when opened; the script itself makes no network calls.

model.rationale: The script lints and renders deterministically, but fixing a broken diagram means reading the author's intent and rewriting syntax without changing nodes, edges or labels, and knowing when to ask instead.
